text: 1、市场早间低开低走，创业板指跌破3000点，科创50指数盘中跌超4%。电池产业链逆势走强，时代万恒5连板，紫竹高科4连板，领湃科技、丰元股份2连板。有机硅板块拉升，东岳硅材、晨光新材涨停。农业股反复活跃，万向德农、金健米业涨停。下跌方面，PCB、CPO等算力硬件股下挫，华正新材、金安国纪跌停。个股跌多涨少，沪深京三市超4300股飘绿，上午半天成交1.18万亿。午间收盘沪指跌1.21%，深成指跌2.09%，创业板跌2.61%。 2、板块概念方面，有机硅、电池、农业、煤炭等板块领涨；算力硬件、军工、消费电子、半导体等板块领跌； 3、两市共997只个股上涨，
text_en: 1. The market opened lower in the morning and fell further, with the ChiNext Index falling below 3000 points and the STAR 50 Index dropping more than 4% intraday. The battery industry chain strengthened against the trend, with Shidai Wanheng posting 5 consecutive limit-ups, Zizhu Gaoke 4 consecutive limit-ups, and Lingpai Technology and Fengyuan Shares 2 consecutive limit-ups. The organosilicon sector rose, with Dongyue Silicon Material and Chenguang New Materials hitting the limit up. Agricultural stocks were repeatedly active, with Wanxiang Denong and Jinjian Rice Industry hitting the limit up. On the downside, PCB, CPO and other computing hardware stocks fell, with Huazheng New Materials and Jin'an Guojii hitting the limit down. More stocks fell than rose, with over 4,300 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets in the green, and half-day turnover of 1.18 trillion yuan. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 1.21%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 2.09%, and ChiNext fell 2.61%. 2. In terms of sectors and concepts, organosilicon, batteries, agriculture, coal and other sectors led gains; computing hardware, military, consumer electronics, semiconductors and other sectors led declines; 3.
